welcome:
🛍 Welcome to {name}!

Browse the menu below:
help: Browse categories, open an item and tap ➕ Add. Open 🛒 Cart to check out: choose a pickup time, share your phone, pay to the account shown, and send the payment screenshot here. You'll get a pickup code when the shop confirms.
contact_admin_none: 📞 The shop has no public username — place an order and they will reach you.
empty_category: 📭 This category is empty for now.
pickup_q: 🕐 When will you collect your order?
pickup_type: Type when you'll collect (e.g. Friday 3pm, or 21/08 10:00):
phone_q: 📱 Share your phone number so the shop can reach you:
phone_invalid: Please tap the button below or type a valid phone number.
pay_text_noinstr:
✅ Order #{id} placed — total {total} {cur}.
The shop has not set payment details yet; they will contact you.
screenshot_only: Please send the payment screenshot as a photo 📸
order_sent: 📨 Order #{id} sent! The shop is checking your payment — you'll get a pickup code once confirmed.
fake_notice: ❌ Order #{id} was rejected — the payment could not be recognised. If you believe this is a mistake, contact the shop.
topup_received: 📨 Screenshot received for order #{id} — the shop is checking it.
no_open_order: You have no order waiting for payment. Browse the menu to place one.
adm_short_ask: How much did you actually receive for order #{id}? Type the amount:
adm_short_saved: Recorded {paid} {cur} for order #{id}. Remaining: {remaining} {cur}. The customer was asked to pay the difference.
adm_confirmed: ✅ Order #{id} confirmed. Pickup code {code} sent to the customer.
adm_faked: ❌ Order #{id} rejected and the customer was notified.
collect_bad: No paid order has that code. Check the digits with the customer.
cancelled_timeout: ⌛ Order #{id} was cancelled — the remaining {remaining} {cur} never arrived. You received {paid} {cur}, which is owed back to {name} ({phone}).
cancelled_customer: ⌛ Order #{id} was cancelled because the remaining payment didn't arrive in time. The {paid} {cur} you already sent is owed back to you — contact the shop to arrange it.
trial_ending: ⏳ Your free trial ends in {days} day(s). Send /subscribe to keep {name} running — {stars} ⭐ for a full year.
